headline: Gold Prices Today, Afternoon of 13/10, Drop Sharply but Remain Nearly 13 Million VND Higher Than World Gold; iPhone 16 Pro Cools Down
summary: Vietnam's domestic gold market showed mixed moves on October 13, with buying prices at many brands falling sharply. The buy-sell spread reached a record high, and domestic prices remained well above world gold.
why: Gold is a store of value and a benchmark commodity, and gaps between domestic and world prices reflect local supply, import rules and demand.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Domestic Vietnamese gold prices and spreads are the subject of the report.
